Congress Demands Home Minister, PM Address Parliament on NEET, Funding Allegations

The Congress party has demanded that Home Minister Amit Shah address Parliament regarding alleged police excesses against students protesting the NEET exam paper leak. Congress leader Jairam Ramesh stated that Shah "lacks the courage" to discuss the Delhi Police's actions in Parliament. The party also called for Prime Minister Narendra Modi to speak on allegations of "chanda chori" (donation theft).
